profiles.schema.json is doc/cascadia/profiles.schema.json of
https://github.com/microsoft/terminal as it was downloaded on 2026-10-07 for
the research behind docs/spec-0.1.md, where it was saved as the file of branch
release-1.24. Its SHA-256 is
62a3807004480d4ced667235abbebadd5571101b73ee4da576a45d5d8d83abd5.
The file is Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation and distributed under the MIT
licence of that repository.

It is here for one test: every key sereno writes into its Windows Terminal
fragment must exist in the schema of the oldest Windows Terminal that sereno
supports (internal/render, TestFragmentKeysExistInTheSchema). Replace it by
the file of a newer release branch only together with that decision.
